$comment: Legacy URLs that Google still holds, mapped to where that page lives now.
rxova.org is served by GitHub Pages, which has no redirect rules — it serves static
files and nothing else. So scripts/redirects.mjs materialises each `from` as a stub
document carrying <meta http-equiv="refresh"> plus a canonical link to `to`, which
is what a search engine reads as a redirect. Browsers follow the refresh.
Every `to` must resolve to a page that exists in the assembled tree; assemble.mjs
fails the deploy if it does not, on the grounds that a redirect into a 404 is worse
than the 404 it was meant to fix.
Entries here are permanent. A redirect is a promise to everyone who linked to the
old URL, and deleting one re-breaks the links it was added to fix — so this list
only ever grows. Trailing-slash variants need no entry: the tree is directory-style,
so /docs/devtool/examples and /docs/devtool/examples/ both resolve to the same stub.
